cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Everything Is a Contest
cards.instruction: Turn every difference or disagreement into a competition you intend to win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I want potatoes; you want pizza. First to peel five chooses. I've done four. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll order pizza unless you can find a cheaper dinner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Potatoes cost nothing. They're already here. I win.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've got a voucher. Pizza's free.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then best free dinner wins. I'll cook potatoes, you order pizza, and Mum can judge. She always asks for my potatoes.

mechanism: A acts as confident contest organizer, adopting B standards and granting choices to keep B participating while shifting toward a contest A can win.
confusable: Distinguish fixed competition or S01 unilateral score ruling from adaptive face-saving rules that enlist B cooperation after each disagreement.
comparison: Dinner preferences become cost then taste contests; tea differences become speed then refill contests.
seedUse: Canonical potatoes/voucher and tea/refills seeds supply B-caused category shifts; S02 needs genuine choice concessions without losing A intent to win.
